title: Rejoice Fullscreen Overlay Menu
description: A fullscreen overlay navigation menu that opens on clicking the 'Menu' button and closes on 'Close'. A single paused GSAP timeline plays/reverses: it animates the overlay clip-path open, staggers the nav links and CTA up with a fade, grows the video preview thumbnail and draws the footer divider from 0 to 100% width.

images.desc: Dark, moody close-up of a hand-held flame-grilled burger against black — the full-page backdrop for the Char burger house
images.role: body background image behind the page content and nav

images.desc: Cinematic grill still — a spatula pressing a smash patty over open flame — used as the kitchen reel preview
images.role: background of the .video-preview panel inside the open overlay menu

intent.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un menú overlay a pantalla completa que se abre con clip-path y revela enlaces escalonados, un reel y un divisor animado.

motion.title: Rejoice Fullscreen Overlay Menu
motion.motion_signature: Paused, reversible GSAP timeline: a top-edge clip-path wipe opens a full-viewport overlay (1s power2.out) while, from the same t=0, links stagger up 60px at 0.05s each (0.75s power1.inOut), a video preview grows 0 -> 200px (1s power2.out) and a footer divider draws 0% -> 100% width (2s power4.out, the tail that sets the 2s total). Close plays the exact same curves backwards.
